description: Solution following Hexagonal architecture and best practices.
releaseNotes:
New Features
      - Add architecture test coverage for Infrastructure and WebApp layers in the Full template.
      - Add a reusable ArchitectureTestHelper to centralize assembly naming, namespace, dependency, and project-reference assertions.

      Improvements
      - Improve architecture tests for Application and Domain with stricter layer-boundary validation and clearer, behavior-oriented test names.
      - Improve unit test project wiring to validate cross-layer constraints by referencing Infrastructure and WebApp test targets.

      Code Quality
      - Remove MockQueryable.Moq dependency from the Full UnitTests template and replace it with an internal EF Core-compatible async queryable test implementation.
      - Refactor repository mock extensions to support async query execution and ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete scenarios in memory.
      - Clean up test comments and formatting for better readability and maintainability.

      Technical Details
      - Update Full template package metadata and lock file entries to align dependency graphs after test infrastructure changes.
      - Keep package versioning aligned with release 10.7.0 publishing workflow.
title: Hexagonal architecture solution template
